name: g02-01 EV/Sales tight margin band in L2 with cascading bands
mechanism: EV/Sales is EV/EBITDA times EBITDA margin, so the margin term dominates sales-multiple dispersion; g01-06 showed a +/-0.05 margin band inside the 2-digit industry removes most of it. Tightening the band to +/-0.03 and still ranking on margin should cancel more of the margin term, with a cascade of wider bands so thin industries keep margin-matched peers instead of falling back to unmatched industry members.
prediction: Median |ln error| below 0.412 (g01-06) and beats the industry median in 4 of 4 years.

spec.name: g02-01 EV/Sales tight margin band in L2 with cascading bands

compact: EV/Sales | screen same industry_l2, band ebitda_margin±0.03 | rank ebitda_margin 2, sales_growth_1y 1, log_sales 1 | k=8, median, min_peers=4 | fallback [same industry_l2, band ebitda_margin±0.05] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.03] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.05] -> [same industry_l2] -> []

name: g02-02 EV/Sales margin and growth bands economy-wide
mechanism: If EV/Sales is governed by cash margin and growth, firms matched on both within hard bands should share the multiple regardless of SIC code. Ranking the survivors on ROIC and size then adjusts for reinvestment efficiency and risk; this tests whether the industry screen in g01-06 adds anything beyond the margin match.
prediction: Median |ln error| below 0.50 and beats the industry median in 4 of 4 years, but does not beat g01-06 (0.412), showing the industry screen still carries risk information.

spec.name: g02-02 EV/Sales margin and growth bands economy-wide

compact: EV/Sales | screen band ebitda_margin±0.04, band sales_growth_1y±0.1 | rank ebitda_margin 2, sales_growth_1y 1, roic 1, log_sales 0.5 | k=10, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [band ebitda_margin±0.04] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.08] -> []

name: g02-03 EV/Sales margin band in L3 with gross margin refinement
mechanism: Within a 3-digit industry, peers share closer business models and risk than within a 2-digit group; adding the EBITDA margin band then fixes the profitability term. Gross margin in the ranking captures pricing power and operating leverage, which shape how durable the current EBITDA margin is.
prediction: Median |ln error| at or below 0.42 and beats the industry median in 4 of 4 years.

spec.name: g02-03 EV/Sales margin band in L3 with gross margin refinement

compact: EV/Sales | screen same industry_l3, band ebitda_margin±0.05 | rank ebitda_margin 2, sales_growth_1y 1, log_sales 1, gross_margin 0.5 | k=8, median, min_peers=4 | fallback [same industry_l2, band ebitda_margin±0.05] -> [band ebitda_margin±0.05] -> [same industry_l2] -> []

name: g02-04 EV/EBITDA L3 with reinvestment-need matching
mechanism: EV/EBITDA capitalizes cash earnings before reinvestment, so firms that must spend more of EBITDA on capex deserve lower multiples at the same growth. Adding capital intensity to the growth, ROIC, leverage and size match of g01-01 should align peers on free-cash-flow conversion, the piece EBITDA hides.
prediction: Median |ln error| below 0.322 (g01-01) and beats the industry median in at least 3 of 4 years.

spec.name: g02-04 EV/EBITDA L3 with reinvestment-need matching

compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l3 | rank sales_growth_1y 1, roic 1, capex_intensity 1, net_debt_to_ebitda 0.5, log_sales 0.5 | k=8, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [same industry_l2] -> []

name: g02-05 EV/EBITDA L2 with growth band
mechanism: Expected growth is the main within-industry driver of EV/EBITDA, so a hard growth band inside the 2-digit industry guarantees peers on a similar growth path while the larger pool allows tighter matching on return on capital, leverage and size. This mirrors the margin-band success for EV/Sales, applied to the dominant EV/EBITDA driver.
prediction: Median |ln error| below 0.333 (industry baseline) and beats the industry median in at least 3 of 4 years.

spec.name: g02-05 EV/EBITDA L2 with growth band

compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l2, band sales_growth_1y±0.1 | rank sales_growth_1y 1, roic 1, net_debt_to_ebitda 0.5, log_sales 0.5 | k=8, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [same industry_l2] -> [band sales_growth_1y±0.1] -> []

name: g02-06 EV/EBITDA L4-first with D&A-share proxy
mechanism: Four-digit SIC peers share product markets and so closer growth and risk outlooks; falling back to L3 then L2 keeps coverage. Including EBIT margin alongside ROIC proxies the share of EBITDA consumed by depreciation (asset intensity), so peers with similar EBIT-to-EBITDA conversion and growth should carry similar EBITDA multiples.
prediction: Median |ln error| at or below 0.325 and beats the industry median in at least 3 of 4 years.

spec.name: g02-06 EV/EBITDA L4-first with D&A-share proxy

compact: EV/EBITDA | screen same industry_l4 | rank sales_growth_1y 1, roic 1, ebit_margin 0.5, net_debt_to_ebitda 0.5, log_sales 0.5 | k=8, median, min_peers=5 | fallback [same industry_l3] -> [same industry_l2] -> []
